patterns.name: AWS Access Key ID
patterns.remediation: Rotate the AWS access key immediately in IAM console and use AWS Secrets Manager or environment variables

patterns.name: AWS Secret Access Key
patterns.remediation: Rotate the AWS secret key immediately and implement proper secret management

patterns.name: GitHub Personal Access Token
patterns.remediation: Revoke the token in GitHub settings and generate a new one, store in environment variables

patterns.name: GitHub OAuth Token
patterns.remediation: Revoke the OAuth token and regenerate with proper scoping

patterns.name: Slack Token
patterns.remediation: Revoke the Slack token and use environment variables or secret management

patterns.name: Slack Webhook URL
patterns.remediation: Regenerate the webhook URL and store securely

patterns.name: Google API Key
patterns.remediation: Regenerate the API key in Google Cloud Console and restrict its usage

patterns.name: Google OAuth Token
patterns.remediation: Revoke the OAuth token and implement proper token management

patterns.name: Private Key
patterns.remediation: Remove the private key immediately, regenerate key pair, and use secure key management

patterns.name: SSH Private Key
patterns.remediation: Remove the SSH key, regenerate key pair, and update authorized_keys on servers

patterns.name: JWT Token
patterns.remediation: Ensure JWT tokens are not hardcoded and use short expiration times

patterns.name: Stripe API Key
patterns.remediation: Rotate the Stripe API key immediately in dashboard and use environment variables

patterns.name: Stripe Restricted Key
patterns.remediation: Rotate the key and implement proper secret management

patterns.name: Twilio API Key
patterns.remediation: Delete the API key in Twilio console and create a new one

patterns.name: Mailgun API Key
patterns.remediation: Regenerate the API key in Mailgun dashboard

patterns.name: SendGrid API Key
patterns.remediation: Delete the API key in SendGrid and create a new one with limited permissions

patterns.name: Heroku API Key
patterns.remediation: Regenerate the API key in Heroku account settings

patterns.name: Generic API Key
patterns.remediation: Review and rotate the API key if valid, use environment variables

patterns.name: Database Connection String
patterns.description: Database connection string with credentials detected
patterns.remediation: Remove hardcoded credentials, use environment variables or secret management

patterns.name: Password in URL
patterns.remediation: Remove password from URL and use secure credential storage

patterns.name: Basic Auth Credentials
patterns.remediation: Use OAuth or API keys instead of basic auth, store credentials securely

patterns.name: Bearer Token
patterns.remediation: Ensure tokens are not hardcoded and implement token rotation

patterns.name: Generic Secret
patterns.remediation: Review the secret and move to environment variables or secret management

patterns.name: Azure Storage Account Key
patterns.remediation: Regenerate the storage account key in Azure portal

patterns.name: Facebook Access Token
patterns.remediation: Revoke the token in Facebook Developer Console

patterns.name: Twitter API Key
patterns.remediation: Regenerate the API key in Twitter Developer Portal

patterns.name: NPM Token
patterns.remediation: Revoke the token in NPM account settings

patterns.name: Docker Hub Token
patterns.remediation: Revoke the token in Docker Hub security settings

patterns.name: GitLab Personal Access Token
patterns.remediation: Revoke the token in GitLab user settings

patterns.name: PyPI Token
patterns.remediation: Revoke the token in PyPI account settings

entropy_check.description: Check for high-entropy strings that might be secrets
